Ansys (Synopsys)

optiSLang

Ansys optiSLang supports process integration, sensitivity analysis and multidisciplinary optimisation.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Connect an analysis workflow

Begin with the selected equations, data, parameters and units. In the intended optiSLang preview, connect an analysis workflow; the visible result is a reproducible model or calculation with declared inputs visible. Review dimensions, assumptions, data quality and numerical range before accepting or exporting it.

Screen influential parameters

Use the operating case, solver settings or experiment space. In the intended optiSLang preview, screen influential parameters; the visible result is computed signals, candidates or numerical results linked to each parameter. Review stability, convergence, sensitivity and expected behaviour before accepting or exporting it.

Optimise and review candidates

Start from the checked plots, tables and requirement references. In the intended optiSLang preview, optimise and review candidates; the visible result is a reviewable notebook, worksheet or result package. Review units, reproducibility, traceability and engineering interpretation before accepting or exporting it.
